relatedSnapshot.title: Cold email daily sending limit under-allocated when a leadless completed campaign remains in the split
relatedSnapshot.description:
## Overview

The cold email daily sending limit is being under-allocated because the even-split logic counts finished campaigns that have no leads, cutting active campaigns' daily capacity by roughly 25%.

## Problem

A customer with 18 active inboxes and 3 active campaigns sends ~470 emails/day instead of ~630 because a fourth, completed campaign (with zero leads) is still counted as active in the split, diluting the daily-limit allocation.

## Root cause

`buildEvenSplitPlan` in `apps/web/lib/inngest/functions/campaign/util.ts` divides total daily capacity (unique inboxes × 35) evenly across every campaign the provider reports as active with a non-empty email list, without excluding campaigns that have no leads. A completed campaign left "active" on the provider (Acquisity-side status desync) is counted, so 18×35=630 splits 4 ways (157 each) instead of 3 ways (210 each).

## Blast radius

622 organizations hold 1,556 leadless "completed" campaigns that are still display-active with a non-empty email list. Counted 2026-09-04: `status = 'completed' AND display_status = 'active' AND total_leads = 0 AND jsonb_array_length(settings->'emailAccounts') > 0`. Confirmed affected: 1 organization (this report); potentially exposed: 622 organizations.

## Proposed fix

Exclude campaigns with no leads (or campaigns Acquisity has marked completed/paused) from the daily-limit even split so capacity is divided only across campaigns that can actually send, and deactivate completed campaigns on the provider so they leave the active list.

## What's included

Fix the split to exclude leadless/completed campaigns; containment is deactivating the ghost campaigns for affected orgs; observability is a signal for leadless campaigns present in the split.

## Regression seam

`buildEvenSplitPlan(campaigns, inboxes)`: given 18 inboxes, 3 campaigns with leads, and 1 leadless campaign, it must return 210/day for each of the 3 real campaigns (not 157) and emit no plan entry for the leadless campaign.

## Done when

* The split excludes leadless/completed campaigns.
* A regression test proves 18 inboxes + 3 leaded campaigns + 1 leadless campaign yields 210 (not 157) per leaded campaign.
* Affected organizations are rebalanced to their full capacity.

## Reports

* ENG-13501

relatedSnapshot.title: Fix 5 bugs identified in automated code review (2026-03-06)
relatedSnapshot.description:
Five bugs found during automated review of commits landed in the last 24 hours.

## Bugs fixed

**1. Silent failures in batch token refresh** (`lib/inngest/functions/integrations/refresh-email-tokens-cron.ts`)
The first `processBatch` call (marking accounts without refresh tokens as invalid) returned `PromiseSettledResult[]` that was immediately discarded. Any unexpected promise rejections were never logged or sent to Sentry. Fixed by capturing the results and logging rejections.

**2. Unbounded duplicate offset in workflow builder** (`components/workflows/builder/workflow-context-menu.tsx`)
`duplicateOffsetRef` accumulated by 24px on every duplicate action for the lifetime of the component. After \~40 duplications nodes would be placed far off-screen. Fixed by resetting the offset to 24 whenever the context menu closes.

**3. Unsaveable "Not set" selection in campaign type selector** (`components/campaigns/detail/tabs/options/campaign-type-selector-card.tsx`)
Selecting "Not set" set `emailScriptsMethod = null` and showed the Save button, but the button was `disabled` when `!emailScriptsMethod` — a broken UX with no explanation. The `handleSave` null guard was also unreachable dead code. Fixed by hiding the Save button when the selected value is null (the API cannot clear the field).

**4. Type-unsafe fallback in campaign imports** (`lib/inngest/functions/campaign/process-campaign-imports.ts`)
`c.raw ?? c` substituted the normalized `WithRaw<NormCampaign>` object when `raw` was absent, then cast it to `Campaign[]`. Downstream code expecting raw provider fields would receive wrong field names silently. Reverted to the original filter-out-undefined behaviour.

**5. Workshop campaign type bypassing DB settings** (`lib/ai-sdr-v2/workflow/helpers/get-call-type.ts`)
The `workshop` branch returned before the `try` block, so it never read `aiSdrSettings` from the database. Unlike `podcast` and `interview`, the workshop call type was hardcoded and could not be configured via AI SDR settings. Moved inside the `try` block and added to the `catch` fallback.

## Related

* ENG-6177 (duplicate step — Workflows project)
* ENG-5915 (AI Audit / workshop — AI SDR project)

Name 1 AI / Ask AI returns empty or failed responses (GPT-5.6 Luna)
relatedSnapshot.description:
Intercom conversation: <url:app.intercom.com>

Bounded context: Customer Name 17 reported "JordanAI/ Ask AI is not working. I keep on running into an error." Fin AI asked her to record a video; she has not supplied it yet.

Testable claim: When a user sends a message to Name 1 AI / Ask AI (AI Consultant) under the default GPT-5.6 Luna model, the assistant intermittently returns an empty or failed response instead of a text reply. Production chat_message rows for this workspace show several completed assistant messages whose parts contain only a reasoning part and no text, plus one message with empty parts and generationStatus "failed". A 7-day production count shows 321 completed assistant messages with no text part across 126 organizations.

Likely root cause: GPT-5.6 Luna emits reasoning-only output. The completion route (apps/web/app/api/completion/route.ts) treats reasoning as persistable content (apps/web/lib/chat/message-content.ts hasRealContent), so the empty reply is saved as completed, while the client never renders it: apps/web/components/ai-chat/utils.ts marks Luna reasoning:false and apps/web/lib/chat/consultant-generation-settings.ts sets reasoning exclude:true for Luna. The user sees a spinner that ends with no answer, which reads as an error.

Foreman support operation: <id>

relatedSnapshot.title: Master: Name 1 AI / Ask AI returns empty replies on GPT-5.6 Luna (reasoning-only output)
relatedSnapshot.description:
## Overview

Name 1 AI / Ask AI intermittently shows no answer under the default GPT-5.6 Luna model. The user sees a spinner that ends in "We couldn't generate a response. Please try again." because the model returned a reasoning-only completion that was persisted as a finished reply with no visible text.

## Problem

A customer asking Ask AI to generate content (for example a one-pager) gets "Processing request" and "Searching knowledge base", then an empty/error state instead of the answer, and can reproduce it by re-sending the prompt.

## Root cause

GPT-5.6 Luna intermittently returns a completion whose only part is a reasoning object with no text. The completion route (apps/web/api/completion/route.ts) persists it because `hasRealContent` in apps/web/lib/chat/message-content.ts counts reasoning as content, while the client (apps/web/lib/chat/assistant-render-plan.ts) has no renderable text part, so the empty reply reads as an error. Luna is configured to exclude reasoning (apps/web/lib/chat/consultant-generation-settings.ts sends reasoning exclude, and apps/web/components/ai-chat/utils.ts marks Luna reasoning: false), yet reasoning-only output still arrives and is stored as an answer.

## Blast radius

336 completed assistant messages in the last 7 days had a reasoning part and no non-whitespace text part, across 130 distinct organizations. Counted 2026-09-10 on PlanetScale production.

## Proposed fix

Treat a completion with reasoning but no renderable text as an empty/failed response (do not persist a usable-looking answer), and either stop Luna from emitting reasoning-only output or surface it correctly to the client.

## What's included

Fix the empty-reply handling for reasoning-only completions on the AI Consultant path, with a regression test. Customer recovery wording is handled on the report tickets.

## Regression seam

Send a Name 1 AI / Ask AI message whose model returns a reasoning-only completion; the client must not show a completed empty answer ending in "We couldn't generate a response" — it should either render answer text or surface a genuine retry/failure rather than a persisted empty message.

## Done when

* A reasoning-only completion is no longer persisted as a visible answered message.
* The customer can get an answer, or a clear retry, from Ask AI.
* A regression test proves the empty-reply path at the persistence/render seam.

## Reports

* ENG-13661 (this report)
* ENG-13629 (prior report of the same cause)
